ai.title: Moving Into *AI & Automation*
paragraphs: The domain knowledge we built in education, finance and marketing now powers our AI and automation work. We know where the manual effort sits in these workflows, so we know where AI actually pays off.

Instead of bolting a chatbot onto a product, we add intelligence where it removes real work: reading documents, answering routine questions, and moving data between systems without anyone copying and pasting.
